description.value:
You spill a drop of blood across a hand seal and call a small toad from Mount Myōboku to your side. The summon arrives in an unoccupied 5-foot square within 30 feet and acts as a Small minion under your control for 1 minute (or until reduced to 0 HP).

The toad has 2 actions per turn, AC 17, 25 HP, and a Strike (tongue) at +9 dealing 1d6+2 bludgeoning. It also benefits from a swim Speed of 25 feet and a 10-foot tongue-grab reach Strike (athletics-style trip on success).

Heightened (+2) Each rank of heightening summons a more powerful toad (use a higher-level minion stat block; see Milestone 6 bestiary). Damage and HP scale with rank.

system.requirements: you have signed the Toad summoning contract
